youtube_description:
Greetings, Family! 

My name is Nils Palsson, and I am running for US Congress for CA's 5th District. Between now and Thursday, 2/25, I am gathering as many signatures as I can -- up to 3,000 of them -- to get my name on the ballot this June. Please join the effort!

You can come by one of the potlucks at my place -- this Sunday or Wednesday --  to sign, and to pick up petition forms to circulate in your community. You can also print the forms yourself, and find more info, at www.peoplesvictory.us/news

Thanks for being a part of the Movement for Truth, Justice, and Thriving Resilience!
